tools.name: search
tools.description: Search upcoming academic conferences, workshops and calls for papers by words in the title, organizer, location or topic. Returns at most 10 events with their ResearchCal page and official source URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the public facts of one event by its id from search: dates, location, public deadlines, official and source URLs, and the public calendar feeds that contain it.

tools.name: list_upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: List open and announced public submission deadlines in date order. Filter by research field, category key, and date range. Returns at most 20 deadlines per call; use next_offset for the next page.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List the public ResearchCal calendar feeds (ICS) with their subscribe URLs, optionally for one research field.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
